messages:
lina: Hey @eng-runtime — we need a tight data package for the launch story: reproducible microbench numbers (p50/p95, tokens/sec), raw CSVs, exact run commands/configs, and a 1-2 line methodology blurb we can paste into the blog. Goal: publish Friday. :pray:

sanjay: We can do that. Which model variants and seq lengths should we include? Also confirm whether to include quantized runs.

lina: Primary: redwood-1.3b (fp16) + an int8 quantized flavor. Sequence lengths: 64, 256, 1024. Please capture streaming on/off and batch sizes 1, 8, 32. Need sample payloads too.

mike: Heads up — our nightly for 1024 was noisy due to mem pressure; I'll schedule a focused smoke run for the longer seqs.

lina: SLA targets for marketing copy (guideline only): p50 < 50ms for 64 tokens on hosted, p95 < 120ms. If numbers differ we'll add a note. Also want a short methodology sentence we can copy.

sanjay: Plan: run each config with 3000 randomized requests, do a 30-request warmup, collect p50/p95/throughput, and export CSV. Using the runtime bench tool like so:

```
./runtime-bench --model redwood-1.3b --variant fp16 --seq 256 --batch 8 --streaming on --runs 3000 --out ./outputs/launch/redwood-1.3b-fp16-256-b8.csv
```

sanjay: I'll upload outputs to /shared/marketing/bench-launch/ and post links here when done.

elaine: Please include GPU type, driver and docker runtime versions in the metadata — press will ask.

runtime-ci-bot: job #546213 queued for redwood-1.3b quantized run (queued by @sanjay).

mike: Note: quantized runs may have small decoding differences; we'll add a short note about deterministic tokenization and model hash.

lina: If we can get initial CSVs by EOD tomorrow we'll draft the post. Also please include a condensed 3-row table we can paste into the deck and a sentence on variance/warmup.

sanjay: Quick question: marketing sample set — should we use public prompts or internal product logs?

lina: Use public prompts + 30 internal support queries for realistic latency. Public examples (paste below):

```
{"prompt":"Summarize the key points of the following doc in 2 bullets.","max_tokens":128}
{"prompt":"Write a concise signup email subject and one-liner for a dev-first API.","max_tokens":64}
{"prompt":"Complete this code snippet: function format(prompt) { /* ... */ }","max_tokens":80}
```

sanjay: Perfect. I'll include a "how we measured" blurb draft for marketing to use.

sanjay: Draft blurb: All numbers measured with 3,000 randomized requests per config after a 30-request warmup; p50/p95 reported over the full run. No cross-request caching unless explicitly noted. Model weights pinned to hash abc123.

mike: tagging @elaine for infra details + to confirm GPU list.

elaine: Hardware/infra metadata: GPU=A100 40GB, driver=525.60, OS=Ubuntu 22.04, docker runtime=nvidia-container-runtime 2.14.

lina: Perfect — thanks. Please drop CSV links and the 3-row deck table here when available. cc: @amanda for PR prep. :rocket:

sanjay: Uploaded initial CSVs and condensed table — https://files.internal/redwood/marketing/launch/initial-csvs.zip and https://files.internal/redwood/marketing/launch/summary-table.csv

sanjay: Summary table (to paste in deck):
- redwood-1.3b fp16 | seq=64 | p50=32ms p95=78ms | tokens/s=420
- redwood-1.3b fp16 | seq=256 | p50=120ms p95=260ms | tokens/s=190
- redwood-1.3b int8  | seq=256 | p50=95ms p95=210ms  | tokens/s=220

lina: This is great — team, we'll use these numbers in the hero graphics and call out quantized run as an optimization. One ask: add a one-sentence note about workload (token length distribution) so readers understand the test mix.

sanjay: Added note in the upload: 60% short (<=64), 30% medium (65-512), 10% long (>512).

mike: Will follow up with a micro-method appendix we can include in the blog repo.

lina: Thanks everyone — keep updates here. If anything slips we'll adjust the release plan. :thumbsup:
